schedule/deleteInactive.description: Delete every ended Host task, leaving active tasks armed. Ended tasks never schedule another delivery, so the removal changes no pending target and no timer is recomputed. Rows are enumerated and removed in one FIFO slot, so a delivery ordered behind this call ends its task after the enumeration rather than during it. The batch is one domain write: a normal failure rejects with every listed row still stored, while a backend `unknown-state` failure may have removed rows and quarantines the Host domain, so later schedule operations reject until the domain is reopened. A successful nonempty batch emits `schedule/changed` without Agent notices. A rejected batch announces `schedule/changed` because it does not establish which rows landed, and clients then re-read the catalog.

subagents/prompt.description: Deliver one browser-authored message to a continuable child through the exact live direct parent, retaining the caller-minted request identity and validated browser zone on the accepted message.
